name: Have you tested the controls and confirmed they're working as intended?
conditionsText: When controls have been designed, built, configured and deployed.
requirementTitle: Have you tested the controls and confirmed they're working as intended?
requirementDescription: Have you checked that the security controls actually work in practice?
why: A control that exists on paper may not work correctly. Secure by Design places emphasis on assessing the effectiveness of security controls and continuing assurance throughout delivery. A control only reduces risk if it operates as intended.
tasks: Have you tested the controls and confirmed they're working as intended?

actions.title: Have you tested the controls and confirmed they're working as intended?
actions.description:
Testing may include:
• Penetration testing.
• Vulnerability scanning.
• Security design reviews.
• Configuration reviews.
• User access testing.
• Red team exercises.
• Evidence-based assurance reviews.
